notes.title: Another Update
notes.notes:
Hiya folks,

Thanks again to everyone buying the game and for the people who have left reviews!

I've just released a small patch there that should fix some of the glitches people are encountering.

FIXED

-Fixed the loading after getting caught.

-Fixed the options menu breaking, you should no longer have to restart.

-Emily will be in the correct position after load.

-Endings now show correct text based on the language you have selected.

-Improved player collision, you won't get stuck as much walking beside objects.


Thanks again and sorry for these bugs, I hope everyone can enjoy the game now!

If you come across anymore bugs you can message me on twitter, the link to my account is in the main menu at the bottom right of the screen.

Matthew.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Hiya folks,

I just wanted to start off by saying thank you to everyone who has purchased the go so far!

I also wanted to apologize for all of the glitches and bugs people have run into, I've been working non stop since release to fix these issue and I believe I have the majority of them fixed now.

There are still a few smaller issues and I'm sure there are bugs I don't know about either but I will continue working on these and fixing these.

I released a patch there that should fix the majority of issues,

-If you have a save at the police station and it's broken, I've added a new button to the main menu that will allow you to start from the beginning of the police station with a new save, I would recommend doing this if your save is broken.

-The game now loads and saves correctly for the majority of objects, previously the game would not load when you loaded into a save, this is why you could not do anything when you reloaded a save, this is now fixed.

-I improved the visual information feedback with the document game, it should be clearer now if you have filled it out correctly.

-The document mini game should no longer display documents you have already completed without allowing you to interact with it.


There are still a few issues,

-After being caught by Emily she may begin moving instantly when you load back in.

-The options menu may stop working, to fix this just restart the game and it will work again.


If you come across anymore bugs you can message me on twitter, the link to my account is in the main menu at the bottom right of the screen.

I will keep working to fix these issues, apologies again for the issues encountered but I hope everyone can enjoy the game now, and thanks again for playing.

Matthew.

notes.title: Release Date
notes.notes:
Hiya folks,

The release of the game has been delayed a little bit due to personal reasons. 

I am glad to announce that the game will now launch on the 7th of April!

Make sure to Wishlist the game for the upcoming release and I'm looking forward to finally releasing the game to you all and I hope you enjoy it!

I've put a lot of effort into this game and I would love to continue making more games after this!
